prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, game-ready HD pixel-art character master. Create ONE young adult male HUMAN swordsman in a square genuinely transparent image. Reference image 1 and reference image 2 are the original PixelLab white-haired male/female NPCs standing in the game lobby: they are the REQUIRED crisp pixel-cluster, edge and facial-detail quality benchmark ONLY, not their luxurious clothing or identity. Reference image 3 is the existing navy-haired green-cloak swordsman: preserve his human proportions, dark navy choppy hair, warm amber eyes, compact youthful adult face, and BASIC starter clothing design and standing pose. Redraw cleanly with substantially clearer organized pixels and readable material boundaries; do not upscale or sharpen the old rendering.
ART: genuine carefully placed pixel clusters, clean 1-pixel selective material-color outlines on a 288-pixel logical square canvas, distinct 2-4 pixel light/shadow facets, small eyes and mouth readable, neat pointed hair locks hugging skull, no scalp gaps, no fuzzy microtexture or stippled noise. Leather straps with restrained seams and small buckles, plain steel breastplate with two or three clean bevels, natural dark cloth folds, boot soles and ankle straps clearly separated. Match the NPCs' game sprite drawing language, not a smooth painted illustration or 3D render. The apparent body height and head-to-body proportions must remain the same as reference image3 at the same view.
CLOTHING: basic modest starter gear ONLY: short plain forest-green shoulder cape with narrow worn ivory hem, a simple light iron chestplate over a plain dark undershirt, dark brown trousers, practical leather belt and simple brown boots/gloves. No crown, large gold trim, gems, engraved ornate armor, magic aura, wings, expensive costume, symbols or scenery. Crispness must come from correct clean drawing, not added ornament. Future premium costumes must look more elaborate than this basic set.
POSE: full body facing S/front with the same subtle top-down view as the references, relaxed balanced standing posture, both feet planted, arms naturally down, no head tilt or action lean. His own right hand (screen left) firmly grips ONE simple straight steel sword at waist height, guard immediately in front of closed fingers, brown hilt visibly passes under the glove and pommel behind the hand, blade angled down and out to screen left, sword tip at ankle/sole height. No extra weapon, fingers, hands or duplicate limbs. Basic sword is as sharply and cleanly drawn as the body.
REGISTRATION: square canvas like image3 with the same generous blank area above, visible head crown at about y106/288 and boot sole/root at y256/288, main body roughly150px tall, head roughly48px wide at288 logical resolution. Do not enlarge him to fill the whole image. Single complete character, exact whole body including sword, no clipping, no ground shadow, no effect, no caption, no grid or reference images drawn in the output. Design the collar/neck boundary cleanly so the whole head (hair and face together) can later be separated as one coherent avatar asset; do not draw a seam, exploded parts or separate heads now. Transparent alpha.
referenceRoles: male white-haired PixelLab NPC: sharpness benchmark only
female white-haired PixelLab NPC: sharpness benchmark only
